overview.zh: 美国监管同日放行Coinbase清算牌照与3倍杠杆ETP，加密合规化提速，而Blast关停与安全事件提醒行业分化加剧。 杠杆产品扩容：SEC批准Cboe BZX上市3倍做多比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油及天然气的ETP，发行方为Volatility Shares。 加密：FN 速递丨Blast 宣布关停：吸金 22 亿，死于零造血 AI安全治理：OpenAI安全报告撰写者David Robinson辞职，并在《大西洋月刊》公开警告AI安全风险，他曾主导《前沿模型准备框架》。

title.zh: Coinbase获得CFTC衍生品清算组织（DCO）牌照批准
title.en: Coinbase Receives CFTC Approval for Derivatives Clearing Organization License

summary.zh:
Coinbase已获得美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）对衍生品清算组织（DCO）牌照的批准，注册主体为其旗下Coinbase Clearing LLC。该注册使Coinbase能够在美国直接为加密衍生品交易提供清算服务。

该注册使Coinbase成为自身衍生品业务的中央对手方，而不再依赖第三方清算机构，从而掌控其美国衍生品业务链条中的又一个环节。

该批准覆盖由Coinbase Clearing处理的完全抵押（fully collateralized）合约；保证金类衍生品业务以及计划推出的个股永续合约（涉及Apple、Tesla、Nvidia）仍沿用其他安排。
summary.en:
Coinbase has received approval from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) for a Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) license, registered for its entity Coinbase Clearing LLC. The registration allows Coinbase to clear crypto derivatives trades directly in the United States.

The registration makes Coinbase a central counterparty for its own derivatives clearing rather than relying on third-party clearinghouses, giving it control over an additional layer of its US derivatives stack.

The approval covers fully collateralized contracts handled by Coinbase Clearing; the margined derivatives business and planned single-stock perpetuals (referenced for Apple, Tesla and Nvidia) continue under separate arrangements.

title.zh: 彭博分析师：美国SEC批准3倍杠杆比特币、以太坊及其他ETP
title.en: Bloomberg Analyst: U.S. SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs

summary.zh:
彭博ETF分析师Eric Balchunas表示，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）已依据《1933年证券法》批准3倍做多比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油及天然气的ETP。他分享的文件显示，Cboe BZX交易所提出的上市与交易这六只产品的规则变更申请获得批准，他称这对发行方Volatility Shares而言是一次重大胜利。

这一批准使美国投资者可获得的交易所上市杠杆加密资产敞口，从现有的现货与期货产品进一步扩展。Balchunas将这一结果称为相关产品发行方Volatility Shares的重大胜利。

这批产品为3倍杠杆产品，标的涵盖六类资产：比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油和天然气。获批的是Cboe BZX提出的允许其上市与交易的规则变更申请，依据为《1933年证券法》。
summary.en:
Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas said the U.S. SEC has approved 3x leveraged long ETPs tied to bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933. The document he shared shows approval of Cboe BZX's proposed rule change to list and trade the six products, a step he described as a major win for issuer Volatility Shares.

The approval widens the range of exchange-listed, leveraged crypto exposure available to U.S. investors beyond the spot and futures products already trading. Balchunas characterized the outcome as a major win for the issuer behind the products, Volatility Shares.

The products are 3x leveraged and cover six underlying assets: bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas. The approval is of Cboe BZX's proposed rule change permitting listing and trading, framed under the Securities Act of 1933.

title.zh: FN 速递丨Blast 宣布关停：吸金 22 亿，死于零造血
title.en: FN Express | Blast Announces Shutdown: Drew In $2.2 Billion, Died from Zero Revenue Generation

summary.zh:
由 NFT 交易市场 Blur 团队推出的以太坊 Layer 2 网络 Blast 宣布关停。其总锁仓量（TVL）已从巅峰约 22 亿美元跌至约 3200 万美元。

此次关停意味着 2024 年最受追捧的 Layer 2 项目之一正式落幕，用户需在截止期限前将剩余资金撤出该网络。

团队表示，该网络的运营成本高于其收入，且看不到弥合这一缺口的现实路径。有报道称用户须在 10 月 26 日前完成提款，而相关资金存放于由三名密钥持有者控制的合约中。
summary.en:
Blast, the Ethereum Layer 2 launched by the team behind NFT marketplace Blur, has announced it is shutting down its network. Its total value locked has fallen from a peak of about $2.2 billion to roughly $32 million.

The wind-down closes out one of the most heavily promoted Layer 2 launches of 2024, and users now face a deadline to move remaining funds out of the network.

The team said the network costs more to run than it earns and that it saw no realistic way to close the gap. Reports say users must withdraw by October 26, with funds held in contracts controlled by three keyholders.

title.zh: 【Consensys 创始人：基础设施事件未影响 MetaMask 钱包，已轮换验证者密钥】
title.en: Consensys founder: infrastructure incident did not affect MetaMask wallets, validator keys rotated

summary.zh:
以太坊联合创始人、Consensys 创始人兼首席执行官 Joseph Lubin 发推表示，根据目前的调查，没有迹象表明 MetaMask 钱包或钱包内的客户资金受到 MetaMask 基础设施事件影响。作为预防措施，其与合作方轮换了验证者密钥，相关验证者须先退出质押队列再重新进入。

Lubin 表示验证者密钥与提款密钥是分开的，其团队不持有客户的提款密钥，因此该事件不会导致质押 ETH 被未授权转移。此次披露显示安全事件已触及 Consensys 部分质押基础设施。

据 Lubin 称，助记词、私钥及钱包资产均未涉及此次事件，由用户自行托管。他表示，团队未公开讨论仍在处理的事件细节，但已向合作方及利益相关方披露并共同应对问题。
summary.en:
Ethereum co-founder and Consensys founder and CEO Joseph Lubin said in a post that, based on the investigation so far, there is no indication that MetaMask wallets or customer funds held in them were affected by a MetaMask infrastructure incident. As a precaution, the team and its partners rotated validator keys, meaning the affected validators must first exit the staking queue and then re-enter it.

Lubin said validator keys and withdrawal keys are separate and that his team does not hold clients' withdrawal keys, which he said prevents the incident from causing unauthorized transfers of staked ETH. The disclosure points to a security issue reaching part of Consensys' staking infrastructure.

According to Lubin, mnemonic phrases, private keys and wallet assets were not involved and remain self-custodied by users. He said the team has not publicly discussed details of the incident that is still being handled, but has disclosed it to partners and stakeholders and is working on the issue with them.

title.zh: NEAR联创谈追回被盗资金：Intents上AI安全层SHIELD锁定黑客
title.en: NEAR co-founder on recovering stolen funds: AI security layer SHIELD on Intents identified the hacker

summary.zh:
10月3日，NEAR联创Illia Polosukhin（@ilblackdragon）在X平台表示，NEAR Intents此前被盗资金已于当日UTC时间14:30全额追回，距攻击发生不到24小时。他将此归功于Intents上的AI安全层SHIELD以及积极的侦查工作，团队据此锁定了责任方并建立了沟通。

在加密黑客事件中全额追回被盗资金并不常见，不到一天完成追回对受影响用户而言与常见的全部损失是截然不同的结果。Polosukhin表示NEAR将持续强化安全系统，并呼吁整个行业以同样的紧迫感回应并展开合作。

Polosukhin表示，AI可能在加速漏洞利用，但也能帮助我们防御这些攻击，NEAR将不断强化安全系统以适应不断变化的网络安全格局。他将此次事件视为全行业保持警惕并开展合作的例证。
summary.en:
NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin (@ilblackdragon) said on X on October 3 that funds stolen from NEAR Intents had been fully recovered by 14:30 UTC that day, less than 24 hours after the attack. He credited the AI security layer SHIELD on Intents, along with active investigative work, with identifying the responsible party and opening communication with them.

Full restitution of exploited funds is uncommon in crypto hacks, so recovery within a day is a materially different outcome for affected users than the usual total loss. Polosukhin said NEAR will keep strengthening its security systems and urged the industry to respond with the same urgency and to cooperate.

Polosukhin said AI may be accelerating exploits, but it can also help defend against them, and that NEAR will continue adapting its security systems to a changing cybersecurity landscape. He framed the episode as a case for industry-wide vigilance and cooperation.

title.zh: Kolibri 是 Aleph Alpha 推出的面向德语和英语的开源权重 LLM
title.en: Kolibri is an open-weight LLM from Aleph Alpha for German and English

summary.zh:
Aleph Alpha 发布了 Kolibri，这是一个针对德语和英语优化的开源权重（open-weight）大语言模型，并同步公开了一份技术报告，记录了其数据集与训练方法。报告发布于 aleph-alpha.com/downloads/tech-report.pdf。

这是来自欧洲“主权 AI”实验室的一次开源权重发布，评论者特别指出，该技术报告对数据集构建与训练流程的披露异常详尽，开放程度少见。

随附的技术报告被描述为一份“如何从零构建现代 agentic LLM”的逐步教程，其中包括数据集是如何制作的。
summary.en:
Aleph Alpha released Kolibri, an open-weight large language model optimized for German and English, together with a technical report that documents its dataset and training recipe. The report is published at aleph-alpha.com/downloads/tech-report.pdf.

It is an open-weights release from a European sovereign-AI lab, and commenters singled out the technical report's unusually detailed disclosure of dataset construction and training as a notable degree of openness.

The accompanying technical report is presented as a step-by-step account of how a modern agentic LLM was built, including how the dataset was assembled.

title.zh: Chainalysis 借助 AI 将 3.87 亿美元 Bitget 被盗资金追踪至朝鲜
title.en: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea

summary.zh:
Chainalysis 于周三发布报告，将 9 月 24 日 Bitget 交易所 3.87 亿美元被盗事件归因于与朝鲜（DPRK）有关联的行为者，并称此次盗窃使与朝鲜相关团伙在 2026 年窃取的加密货币总额超过 10 亿美元。该公司表示，自攻击发生以来一直与 Bitget 及执法部门合作，跨多条区块链追踪这些资金。

这一归因让一家主要区块链分析公司的判断加入日益一致的共识：Bitget 首席执行官 Gracy Chen 曾表示攻击特征与朝鲜黑客相符，Elliptic 也称朝鲜关联的可能性"很高"。Chainalysis 还表示，该事件使朝鲜相关方 2026 年的加密盗窃总额超过 10 亿美元。

在最初三小时内，3.87 亿美元资金通过 23 笔转账离开 Bitget，流向以太坊（49.7%）、XRP（40.8%）、Zcash（7.6%）和波场 Tron（1.8%）。Chainalysis 表示，其自研 AI 自动化将原本估计超过 20 小时的手动跨链桥对账压缩到 10 分钟以内，并强调该技术只是加快调查人员的工作，而非取代他们。
summary.en:
Chainalysis published a report on Wednesday attributing the $387 million Bitget exchange hack of Sept. 24 to actors tied to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, saying the heist pushed the total value of crypto stolen by North Korea-linked groups in 2026 past $1 billion. The firm said it had been working with Bitget and law enforcement to trace the funds across multiple blockchains since the attack.

The attribution adds the weight of a major blockchain analytics firm to a growing consensus: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said the attack's patterns matched North Korean hackers, and Elliptic called a DPRK link "highly likely." Chainalysis also said the incident pushed North Korea-linked crypto theft in 2026 past $1 billion.

In the first three hours, $387 million left Bitget across 23 transfers, landing on Ethereum (49.7%), XRP (40.8%), Zcash (7.6%) and Tron (1.8%). Chainalysis said in-house AI automation compressed an estimated 20-plus hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes, while stressing the technology accelerated investigators rather than replacing them.

title.zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体，代表 DAO 持有协议知识产权
title.en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Hold Protocol IP for the DAO

summary.zh:
Aave Labs 提议设立“Aave 基金会”（Aave Foundation），这是一家无成员的开曼群岛基金会公司，将代表 Aave 协议持有 Aave 商标及相关协议知识产权的法定所有权。该提案以 ARFC 形式发布在 Aave 治理论坛，并获得创始人 Stani Kulechov 的支持，目前仅涵盖第一阶段：注册该实体并任命其首批独立管理人员。

该提案将为 DAO 的品牌与代码库知识产权提供一个获得法律承认的链下载体，对 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一而言属于结构性变化。根据提案内容，基金会不会掌控协议决策，AAVE 代币持有者保留现有治理权力。

提案将设立实体描述为多个阶段中的第一步，商标与域名的转移将另行提交治理投票。该实体将是一家无成员的开曼群岛基金会公司。
summary.en:
Aave Labs has proposed creating the Aave Foundation, a memberless Cayman Islands foundation company that would hold legal title to the Aave trademark and related protocol intellectual property for the benefit of the Aave Protocol. The request, posted as an ARFC on the Aave governance forum and backed by founder Stani Kulechov, covers Phase 1 only: incorporating the entity and appointing its initial independent officers.

The proposal would give the DAO a recognized off-chain legal wrapper for its brand and codebase IP, a structural change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols. According to the proposal, the foundation would not control protocol decisions, with AAVE token holders retaining existing governance powers.

Formation is described as the first of several phases, with trademark and domain transfers to be subject to separate governance votes. The entity would be a memberless Cayman Islands foundation company.

title.zh: 纽约梅隆银行正与Kraken母公司洽谈基础设施合作
title.en: BNY Mellon in talks with Kraken parent over infrastructure partnership

summary.zh:
据消息人士透露，纽约梅隆银行（BNY）正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈一项潜在的数字资产基础设施合作，相关报道日期为10月3日。洽谈内容可能覆盖数字资产、托管、交易、支付、财富管理及其他金融市场基础设施，相关服务拟通过Payward Services向银行、交易所和资管机构提供。

若合作达成，全球最大的托管银行将与支撑Kraken的基础设施相连，把BNY现有的托管、清算、支付和财富管理业务延伸至数字资产轨道。不过相关洽谈尚未得到证实，且被描述为引述匿名人士的早期磋商。

据CoinDesk报道，该安排可能与Payward近期与纳斯达克达成的商业协议中的基础设施部分相似。BNY目前已在为机构客户提供托管、资产服务、清算、支付和财富管理服务，而Payward Services表示其让金融科技公司、银行、交易所和链上平台直接接入支撑Kraken的基础设施。
summary.en:
BNY Mellon (BNY) is in talks with Kraken parent company Payward over a potential digital-asset infrastructure partnership, people familiar with the matter said, in a report dated October 3. The discussions could cover digital assets, custody, trading, payments, wealth management and other financial market infrastructure, with services to be offered to banks, exchanges and asset managers through Payward Services.

A tie-up would connect the world's largest custodian bank with the infrastructure that has powered Kraken, extending BNY's existing custody, clearing, payments and wealth-management businesses onto digital-asset rails. The talks remain unconfirmed and are described as early-stage discussions sourced to unnamed people.

The arrangement could resemble the infrastructure component of Payward's recent commercial agreement with Nasdaq, according to CoinDesk. BNY already provides custody, asset servicing, clearing, payments and wealth-management services to institutional clients, while Payward Services says it gives fintechs, banks, exchanges and onchain platforms direct access to the infrastructure behind Kraken.

title.zh: OpenAI一名安全部门员工已辞职并发出警告
title.en: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm

summary.zh:
曾为OpenAI重大模型发布撰写安全报告的David Robinson本周辞职，并在《大西洋月刊》（The Atlantic）刊发评论文章，公开就AI安全风险发出警告。据有关其离职的报道，他在OpenAI工作约三年半，主导起草了现行的《前沿模型准备框架》（Preparedness Framework），并负责监督12次前沿模型发布的安全报告工作。

Robinson是OpenAI重大模型发布配套安全文件的撰写者，因此他的公开批评会加剧外界对前沿实验室如何开展和披露安全监督的关注。有关其离职的报道称，他希望AI实验室借鉴航空与核能领域的安全实践。

据报道，Robinson负责OpenAI的安全透明度工作，并参与了介绍其模型情况的系统卡（system card）的编写。有报道标题称他将OpenAI的文化形容为“已崩坏”，这一说法来自媒体的引述。
summary.en:
David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, resigned this week and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial published by The Atlantic. According to reports on his departure, he spent about three and a half years at OpenAI, led the drafting of its current Preparedness Framework, and oversaw safety reporting on 12 frontier launches.

Robinson authored the safety documentation that accompanied OpenAI's major model releases, so his public criticism adds to outside scrutiny of how frontier labs conduct and disclose safety oversight. Reports on his exit say he wants AI labs to draw lessons from aviation and nuclear safety practices.

Robinson ran OpenAI's safety transparency work and took part in developing the system cards that describe its models, according to reports. One report headline described him as calling OpenAI's culture "broken," a characterization attributed to him in press coverage.

title.zh: Jev估值100亿美元！创始人Diogo Almeida回答一切
title.en: Jev Valued at $10 Billion! Founder Diogo Almeida Answers Everything

summary.zh:
AI 初创公司 Jev 估值达到 100 亿美元，创始人 Diogo Almeida 就公司及其发展方向回答了一系列问题。此次问答发生在 Jev 作为 TypeSafe 打造的模型结束隐身状态、公开亮相之后。

据报出的 100 亿美元估值，将使 Jev 跻身高估值的新兴 AI 公司之列，也反映出投资者注意力正向新一批模型厂商快速集中。

Jev 是由 TypeSafe 开发的模型，这家位于旧金山的初创公司由 Diogo Almeida、Erik Gafni 和 Sasha Sheng 于 2024 年创立，Jev 之名取自杰文斯悖论。TypeSafe 将 Jev 描述为一种“前沿智能函数调用”——输入非结构化状态，输出带类型的概率决策，而非对话式聊天机器人。
summary.en:
AI startup Jev has reached a $10 billion valuation, and founder Diogo Almeida has answered a wide range of questions about the company and its direction. The Q&A follows Jev's emergence from stealth as a model built by TypeSafe.

A $10 billion valuation, as reported, would place Jev among the most highly valued young AI companies, underscoring how quickly investor attention has concentrated on new model entrants.

Jev is the model developed by TypeSafe, the San Francisco startup founded in 2024 by Diogo Almeida, Erik Gafni and Sasha Sheng, and its name references the Jevons paradox. TypeSafe describes Jev as a frontier-intelligence function call — unstructured input in, typed probabilistic decisions out — rather than a conversational chatbot.

title.zh: Claude 前沿学院：投入 1 亿美元培养 1 万名工程师
title.en: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers - anthropic.com

summary.zh:
Anthropic 宣布推出 Claude 前沿学院（Claude Frontier Academy），承诺投入 1 亿美元，到 2027 年底培养 1 万名“前沿部署工程师”（Frontier Deployed Engineer）。该项目被描述为一种驻留式培养计划而非普通课程，由各机构提名其最优秀的工程师参与，围绕 Claude 进行实操训练。

该项目把 Anthropic 的 Claude 生态与大规模企业工程团队直接挂钩，其公开目标是让参与者的能力达到 Anthropic 自家部署工程师的水平。

根据项目说明，参与机构需提名工程师，并在其所在组织内部构建真实的 Claude 项目；有介绍称该计划包含为期数天的线下环节，随后是 12 周的项目实践期。
summary.en:
Anthropic announced the Claude Frontier Academy, a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The program is described as a residency rather than a course, in which organizations nominate their strongest engineers for hands-on work with Claude.

The program ties Anthropic's Claude ecosystem to enterprise engineering teams at scale, with the stated goal of bringing participants to the standard of Anthropic's own deployed engineers.

According to the program description, participating organizations nominate engineers who build real Claude projects inside their own organizations; one account describes a multi-day in-person segment followed by a 12-week build period.
